title: Are Low-Cost Flights Getting Harder to Get? AI Is Changing Airlines' Pricing Logic

content_html:
July 30th news, airlines are accelerating the introduction of AI dynamic pricing technology, and the opportunity for passengers to buy low-price tickets for popular flights through "hunting for deals" may further decrease in the future. Airlines such as Delta and Virgin are using artificial intelligence to analyze market demand and adjust ticket prices in real time to increase flight revenue.

Previously, airline ticket prices were mainly set by human rules, such as setting a uniform price increase based on the proportion of tickets sold. However, with the application of AI technology, airlines can now comprehensively analyze dozens of factors, including purchasing behavior, route demand, time changes, and seat sales, and optimize prices in real time for different seats.

According to Bloomberg, in the context of continuously rising operating costs, airlines hope to increase revenue per flight through AI pricing. For popular routes, the system can reduce the supply of low-price tickets below what consumers are willing to pay, while helping flights improve occupancy rates and revenue levels.

Industry experts believe that the traditional model of managing ticket prices based on fixed rules and spreadsheets is gradually being phased out, and predictive model-driven dynamic pricing is becoming an important trend in the aviation industry. AI not only helps airlines increase prices during periods of high demand but also allows them to adjust strategies quickly during market downturns to stimulate ticket purchases.

Brian Terry, an analyst at Altus Aviation Consulting, said consumers need to adapt to a more intelligent pricing system. In the future, airline pricing will be more flexible and accurate, and the speed of price changes may also increase further.

As AI becomes more deeply integrated into business decision-making, airfare competition is shifting from traditional manual experience-based adjustments to real-time optimization based on data and algorithms. For consumers, this means more precise market matching, but it may also reduce the chance of encountering extremely low-price tickets that used to appear occasionally.

content_html_zh:
7月30日消息，航空公司正在加速引入AI动态定价技术，未来旅客通过“猎抢优惠”购买热门航班低价机票的机会可能会进一步减少。 达美航空和维珍航空等航空公司正在利用人工智能分析市场需求并实时调整机票价格，以增加航班收入。

此前，机票价格主要由人为规则设定，比如根据售出的机票比例设定统一涨价。 然而，随着人工智能技术的应用，航空公司现在可以综合分析购买行为、航线需求、时间变化、座位销售等数十种因素，针对不同座位实时优化价格。

据彭博社报道，在运营成本不断上升的背景下，航空公司希望通过人工智能定价来增加每架航班的收入。 对于热门航线，该系统可以将低价机票的供应量减少到低于消费者愿意支付的水平，同时帮助航班提高上座率和收入水平。

业内专家认为，基于固定规则和电子表格的传统机票价格管理模式正在逐步被淘汰，预测模型驱动的动态定价正在成为航空业的重要趋势。 人工智能不仅可以帮助航空公司在需求旺盛时期提高价格，还可以让他们在市场低迷时期快速调整策略以刺激机票购买。

Altus Aviation Consulting 分析师 Brian Terry 表示，消费者需要适应更智能的定价系统。 未来，航空公司的定价将更加灵活、准确，价格变化的速度也可能进一步加快。

随着人工智能更加深入地融入商业决策，机票竞争正在从传统的基于经验的人工调整转向基于数据和算法的实时优化。 对于消费者来说，这意味着更精准的市场匹配，但也可能减少遇到以往偶尔出现的极低价门票的机会。
